Formables.Name: England
Formables.Description: Unify the English shires under one crown and leave the British union behind.

Formables.Name: Scotland
Formables.Description: Highland clans and lowland burghs meet to reclaim the old northern parliament.

Formables.Name: Bavaria
Formables.Description: Munich calls the Alpine lands back into their own kingdom.

Formables.Name: Prussia
Formables.Description: The old east-Elbian order marches again, drill and bureaucracy first.

Formables.Name: Two Sicilies
Formables.Description: Naples and Palermo close ranks against the northern kingdom.

Formables.Name: Sardinia
Formables.Description: The island and the alpine foothills draw up their own statute.

Formables.Name: Papal States
Formables.Description: Rome restores its temporal rule over the patrimony of St. Peter.

Formables.Name: Castile
Formables.Description: The high plain remembers who held the cortes before the union.

Formables.Name: Aragon
Formables.Description: Ebro valley towns and the Balearic coast revive the old confederation.

Formables.Name: Navarre
Formables.Description: The Pyrenean kingdom takes back the passes its borders once held.

Formables.Name: Novgorod
Formables.Description: The veche returns to the northern lakes and the Hanseatic wharves.

Formables.Name: Siberia
Formables.Description: The taiga and the railway towns form a government of their own.

Formables.Name: Georgia
Formables.Description: Caucasian valleys and vineyards unite under the restored Bagration crown.

Formables.Name: Hanseatic League
Formables.Description: Merchant houses of the north sea coast sign a new kontor treaty.

Formables.Name: Burgundy
Formables.Description: The duchy between Saône and Rhine reassembles its court and order.
